Name: Flagged Fish
Author: JunMonarch
Description:
Content Patcher required.

This mod replaces the sprites for some fish to feature some pride flags.

I will be updating it with more flags, if you have any suggestions for fish and flag let me know and i'll do my best to add it!

Fish added:
Transmouth Bass (Largemouth Bass)
Gaybow Trout (Rainbow Trout)

How to install:

1) Download and install SMAPI and Content Patcher.

2) Download the ZIP file and extract it on the Mods folder.

3) Enjoy!
